prompts.prompt: For Express to treat a middleware function as an error handler rather than a normal one, exactly how many parameters must its function signature declare? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/express/SKILL.md - Error-handling middleware is distinguished solely by its 4-parameter signature. Express checks function.length to identify it.

prompts.prompt: What is the minimum Node.js version required to run Express 5? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/express/SKILL.md - Express 4 vs Express 5 table: Node.js minimum Node 10+ (v4) vs Node 18+ (v5)

prompts.prompt: In Express 5, if an async route handler throws or rejects, does it get forwarded to your error-handling middleware automatically, or do you still need an explicit call passing the error to next? Answer in one sentence.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/express/SKILL.md - Express 5: Async errors in route handlers are automatically forwarded to error middleware -- no try/catch or asyncHandler wrapper needed.
